release_notes: Organize recipes into shared folders, such as Jen’s Favorites or Holiday Baking, without duplicating them.
Find recipes instantly by folder or category from the web home page and recipe collection.
Filter recipes by folder or category right on the Android Recipes screen.
Choose several folders and a category when creating or editing a recipe on web or Android.
Create, rename, and delete folders; deleting a folder never deletes its recipes.
Existing recipes, photographs, and family approval rules are preserved.
